run_update_file: run the script to update annotated data files with new parse trees from an updated dataset
run_write_data_chunk: run the script to write a chunk of data lines to a file with optional commands-only mode
run_load_file_as_dictionary: run the script to load a pipe-delimited data file into a command-to-action dictionary
refactor_update_file: refactor the update_file function to support additional data formats beyond pipe-delimited text
review_write_data_chunk_to_file: review the write_data_chunk_to_file function and its commands_only flag for writing filtered output
